data.description: Polished AJAX form submission. Submits the form via fetch, swaps the form for a success card, and dispatches events that addons like 'toast' and 'confetti' can bridge to.

data-aed-form-endpoint.description: Override the form's `action` attribute (useful when the form posts to a third-party handler like Formspree).

data-aed-form-success-body.description: Body copy of the success card.

data-aed-form-redirect.description: If set, the visitor is redirected to this URL instead of seeing the success card.

api.description: Other addons subscribe to these CustomEvents on `document`. detail = { form, response } or { form, error }. Confetti and toast both auto-bridge.
